author: SimonVlal
quote:
If you expect a raw GTA-game, this isn't it. If you're into games TLOU2, Mixtape or Dragon Age: The Veilguard you'll probably love this one. The problem is, that it really isn't made for it's core audience. 

This game is really bloated and has a slow paced story with restrictive gameplay. They've basicly watered down everything great about the franchise. Also the technical limitations are annoying with regards to low fps. The world is pretty to look at, but nothing too out of the ordinary of what's expected from triple A titles.

author: SimonVlal
quote: Feels great to play! Also very dynamic and interesting combat. Very cool overall aesthetic too. 10/10!

author: SimonVlal
quote: Looks and feels amazing. 10/10. Refreshing take on the open-world genre. I really like the fact there is no "minimap and arrows", and that you actually have to pay attention to the envoirment.
